ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - System Informer Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of System Informer, a task manager tool to view and manipulate processes, kernel options and other low level operations

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\SystemInformer\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "SystemInformer\.exe" OR process_description = "System\ Informer" OR process_product = "System\ Informer" OR (process_hash = RGX(".*MD5\\=19426363A37C03C3ED6FEDF57B6696EC.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA1\\=8B12C6DA8FAC0D5E8AB999C31E5EA04AF32D53DC.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA256\\=8EE9D84DE50803545937A63C686822388A3338497CDDB660D5D69CF68B68F287.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=B68908ADAEB5D662F87F2528AF318F12.*")))
